subject: Billing contact update, PO & W-9 for renewal + capacity add
messages:
From: Ava Patel <ava.patel@brightbridge.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Joel Carter <joel.carter@brightbridge.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO and W-9 for upcoming renewal + 20% capacity add

Hi Priya,

Quick note from procurement as we finalize our renewal: BrightBridge is ready to sign the 12-month renewal, and we'd like to add a 20% capacity uplift to accommodate an upcoming pilot. Our billing team needs a formal PO and Redwood's updated W-9 on file before we can process payment. Also, Finance is requesting Net60 terms for this renewal (we're consolidating vendors onto Net60 across Q3).

Can you confirm you can accept a PO (we will send PO #BB-77851) and provide the W-9 and an invoice reflecting Net60? If Net60 is an issue, please let me know ASAP so we can adjust timing on our side.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Ava Patel
Procurement Lead, BrightBridge, Inc.
ava.patel@brightbridge.ai
+1 (415) 555-0134

[Attachment: BrightBridge_PO_77851.pdf (application/pdf) — draft PO attached by BrightBridge]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Ava Patel <ava.patel@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Joel Carter <joel.carter@brightbridge.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO and W-9 for upcoming renewal + 20% capacity add

Hi Ava — thanks for the heads up and for sending the draft PO.

Short answers:
- Yes, we can accept a PO. Please send the final PO PDF (PO number and billing entity must match the invoice).
- Attached is our current W-9 (Redwood Inference).
- I can provision an invoice showing the base renewal plus the 20% capacity uplift and add Net60 payment terms, pending finance approval.

Two quick asks from our side to keep things moving:
1) Please confirm the billing contact name and email that should appear on the invoice (your AR team or a shared billing mailbox?).
2) Can you confirm whether the PO needs to include the legal entity 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' or the parent holding company? That affects the EIN on the invoice.

I'm looping in Marcus (finance) and Naomi (customer success) to confirm Net60 and to schedule provisioning for the capacity add once the PO is finalized.

Thanks — I aim to get a draft invoice back to you same day once Marcus signs off.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_W9_2028.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ava Patel <ava.patel@brightbridge.ai>, Joel Carter <joel.carter@brightbridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO and W-9 for upcoming renewal + 20% capacity add

Priya — quick internal note then reply to customer below.

We can approve Net60 for BrightBridge on this renewal provided: (1) the PO is received and matches the invoice entity and EIN, (2) there are no outstanding invoices with >60 days overdue, and (3) the deal remains at or above the committed monthly spend threshold in DB-77851. Legal would like a short amendment to capture the Net60 change and the capacity add — I drafted a one-page amendment (attached).

If you could confirm Ava's billing contact, we'll prepare the invoice. I'll also generate a billing holdback flag if there's any variance in usage over the first 30 days of the uplift.

I'll reply to Ava with a Net60 confirmation and attach the amendment for signature (DocuSign link included).

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Revenue Operations
marcus_lin@redwood.com

--- Forwarded reply to customer below ---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ava Patel <ava.patel@brightbridge.ai>, Joel Carter <joel.carter@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 08:48:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood renewal — PO and Net60

Hi Ava / Joel,

Thanks for the PO draft and for flagging the capacity uplift. Redwood can accept PO BB-77851 and we are able to offer Net60 for this renewal following internal approval. Attached is a short amendment that documents the payment-term change and the 20% capacity add. Please review and sign via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/XYZ-AMPLIFY-77851

Next steps we need from BrightBridge:
- Final PO PDF with PO # BB-77851 and billing entity confirmed
- Signed amendment via DocuSign
- Confirmation of billing contact to appear on the invoice (name + email)

Once the signed amendment and PO are received, we'll issue the invoice with Net60 terms and process the capacity uplift for provisioning.

Best regards,
Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations
[Attachment: Amendment_NET60_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Ava Patel <ava.patel@brightbridge.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Joel Carter <joel.carter@brightbridge.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood renewal — PO and Net60

Hi Marcus / Priya — thanks for the quick turnaround.

Attached is the finalized PO with the billing entity set to 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' and PO number BB-77851. I've also signed the DocuSign amendment; you should see the completed envelope under the link you provided. Please proceed to issue the invoice with Net60 terms. Billing contact for our AR team: Joel Carter <joel.carter@brightbridge.ai>.

One last ask — can you include a line on the invoice showing the capacity uplift quantity along with a short description ("20% pilot uplift — July 2028 to June 2029") so our AP system can map the charge correctly?

Thanks — looking forward to the lifted capacity going live.

Best,
Ava Patel
Procurement Lead, BrightBridge, Inc.

[Attachments: BrightBridge_PO_77851.pdf (application/pdf), DocuSign_envelope_77851.pdf (application/pdf) — signed amendment copy]
